operations.name: Bailey Marie Baldus

expected.charges: Burglary/riot-related offense (unrest at a St. Paul store)
expected.sentence: Caught on surveillance with co-defendants at a St. Paul health and nutrition store during the May 28, 2020 unrest after George Floyd's death. Charges were dropped after her attorney argued she was present but did not participate.

updates.prosecutor: Matthew S. Ebert; Joseph S. Teirab

operations.source: Primary DOJ June 9, 2020 announcement individually names Baldus, initial-appearance judge and prosecutors: https://www.justice.gov/usao-mn/pr/two-individuals-charged-arson-st-paul-health-and-nutrition-store . No arrest/admission date inferred from complaint filing or initial appearance; later dismissal is not presumed physical release.

operations.name: Cody Andrew Kretsinger

expected.charges: Conspiracy and unauthorized impairment of a protected computer — 2011 LulzSec intrusion into Sony Pictures
expected.sentence: One year and one day in federal prison imposed April 18, 2013, followed by one year of home detention, 1,000 community-service hours and $605,663 restitution. Official BOP register 49612-308 gives June 4, 2014 as the federal custody endpoint, not proof of completion of home detention or supervised release. Actual admission remains unverified.

operations.source: Primary DOJ April 18, 2013 individual sentencing announcement: https://www.justice.gov/file/487861/dl . Judge explicitly named. Sentencing date is not used as actual prison admission; existing custody endpoint preserved.

operations.name: Matilda Young

expected.charges: Arrested for picketing the Wilson White House for woman suffrage.
expected.convicted: Imprisoned in the 1917-1919 National Woman's Party suffrage campaign
expected.sentence: November 10, 1917: 15 days; January 1919: one five-day and one three-day term.

operations.source: Doris Stevens, Jailed for Freedom (1920), Appendix 4 individual Matilda Young entry, and contemporary protest account: https://www.gutenberg.org/cache/epub/3604/pg3604-images.html ; https://suffragistmemorial.wordpress.com/tag/night-of-terror/ . November 10 White House picketing arrest; later November 12 rearrest and November 14 admission are distinct stages. Existing populated dates preserved.
